versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02037 If ComEnableMDTForCyclicTransmission is configured to false, the minimum delay timer shall not be (re)started in the following cases: • I-PDUs with ComTxModeMode PERIODIC • the cyclic part of I-PDUs with ComTxModeMode MIXED • repeated transmissions for I-PDUs in case ComTxModeNumberOfRepetitions > 0
